pattern: ToolExecutor defaults workspace to D:/ (drive root) instead of project directory, causing LLM to operate on wrong files
fix: Set ToolExecutor default workspace to project directory

pattern: File reads >20K chars overflow the context window, causing token limit errors
fix: Truncate file read results exceeding 20K characters before sending to LLM

pattern: Token budget of 50K max_total_tokens too low for multi-step tasks, causing premature termination
fix: Increase max_total_tokens default from 50K to 100K (eval) or 200K

pattern: Untrimmed messages cause context overflow (1.8M tokens to 1M limit model) when tool results accumulate across iterations
fix: Enforce context window BEFORE the LLM call in _run_iteration(), not just after

pattern: Workspace pollution from previous tasks — LLM finds leftover files and misses the actual target file (E08)
fix: Clean workspace between eval tasks to prevent stale file interference

pattern: LLM doesn't read config.json before modifying main.py, hardcodes values instead (E40)
fix: Ensure LLM reads dependency files (config.json) before modifying code that references them

pattern: LLM modifies test file incorrectly, resulting in test file not found or malformed test (E41)
fix: Verify test file integrity after LLM modifications; ensure test discovery still works

pattern: LLM refactoring magic numbers changes numeric precision, breaking assertions (E29)
fix: Preserve numeric precision and literal values during refactoring; only extract truly duplicated constants

pattern: Windows subprocess/pipe handling incompatible with pipe processing tests (E23)
fix: Handle Windows-specific subprocess and pipe incompatibilities in CLI tool execution

pattern: Long system prompt + complex context causes DeepSeek to use text descriptions instead of structured tool_calls
fix: Simplify SYSTEM_PROMPT and clarify task description format to favor tool_calls over text

pattern: Cyclomatic complexity HIGH in helper methods (_remember_tool_result, _save_session_memory, _enforce_context_window)
LLM appends to file instead of replacing content (E10 — expected NEW LINE but got existing content)
fix: Ensure token budget is sufficient and LLM uses write mode instead of append when task requires full replacement
